data.name: Jacquenetta
data.gender_notes: Jacquenetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jacquenetta is derived from the Latin name Jacqueline, which is composed of the elements 'Jacques' meaning 'supplanter' and 'line' meaning 'little'. The name Jacquenetta can be interpreted as 'God's gracious little supplanter' or 'Supplanter of the Lord'. The name Jacquenetta carries the meaning “God's gracious gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jacquenetta usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
